children: The $174 bln weight loss pioneer plans to expand in new treatments. Yet a promised extra $23 bln of revenue by 2035 will barely offset the loss of sales as its core Wegovy franchise comes off patent. And regaining ground will be hard in an obesity market fat with new competition.
Full view will be published shortly.
Novo Nordisk said on September 21 it aims to launch more than five blockbuster drugs by 2030 and to deliver more than 150 billion Danish crowns ($23 billion) in pipeline sales in 2035.
On September 22 the company told Reuters that weight-loss pills could capture as much as ​half of the global obesity drug market by 2030.
Shares in Novo Nordisk fell 8% following the announcement of its targets on September 21.
